intro: The Druids of the Fang are a splinter sect of night elf druids who succumbed to corruption deep within the Wailing Caverns. Originally disciples of the visionary Naralex, they abandoned the Cenarion Circle after their master's connection to the Emerald Dream turned into a foul nightmare. Under the self-proclaimed Lord Serpentis, they now wield serpent-like forms and seek to remake the Barrens into their own twisted paradise.

p: The Barrens was not always an arid wasteland, and Naralex sought to return it to the lush, verdant sanctuary it once was. Naralex led a dedicated order of young druids into the subterranean depths of the Wailing Caverns, tapping into the natural underground fissures and subterranean springs. By entering an induced slumber, Naralex hoped to channel the living energies of the Emerald Dream into the waterways, nursing the scorched savannah above back to vibrant life.
